title: DocumentIndexed (v1)
description: The document's chunks are embedded and upserted into the vector store; it is searchable. Written by the embedder.

source.description: Only these services may write DocumentIndexed.

data.description: Only facts a consumer needs to act; nothing that can be looked up. Unknown fields tolerated (additive v1).

collection.description: Qdrant collection the chunks live in (the public demo uses a separate one).

chunk_count.description: How many chunks were upserted. 0 is legal (empty document) and still means 'indexed'.

embedding_model.description: Model that produced the vectors; changing it means re-indexing.

embedding_dim.description: Vector size; must match the collection.
